Why AI visibility matters now: a growing share of people looking for a dance studio ask ChatGPT, Gemini, or Google's AI overview before they ever open a map. Studios that don't structure their site for those tools simply don't get mentioned — regardless of how good the studio actually is. In our checks, every studio the AI engines named was inside Glendale itself — none of the eleven studios in Encino, North Hollywood, Reseda, Sherman Oaks, Tarzana or Van Nuys came up.

Methodology: the field is every adult ballroom, Latin or partner-dance studio with a working website that appeared in Google's local results for Glendale dance searches on 18 Oct 2026. The Los Angeles area is split into six pages: Los Angeles (the city and the Westside), Glendale (with the San Fernando Valley), Pasadena (the San Gabriel Valley), Long Beach (with the South Bay), Anaheim (north Orange County) and Irvine (central and south Orange County). The Valley studios are in the city of Los Angeles but are ranked here, apart from the city page. Dance Attractions and The Tango Room share a building in Sherman Oaks and are rated separately. Each studio's site was crawled and graded across seven categories (AI readiness, SEO basics, page structure, content depth, social, image alt text, technical) on the same day. Google local positions come from four searches (ballroom dance lessons glendale ca, dance lessons glendale ca, salsa lessons glendale ca and wedding dance lessons glendale ca). AI visibility reflects live sessions in the public ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI apps, asked the two queries shown above; presence was confirmed by reading each engine's raw answer directly. This is an independent measurement by Ballroom Dance Directory, not commissioned by any studio named above. Rankings reflect a point-in-time snapshot and will be re-run periodically. The complete scorecard, Google table and AI answers are in the detailed report.

In Glendale, 14 studios compete for dance students. None has finished the work AI search now rewards.

We audited 14 dance and ballroom studios serving the Glendale market head to head: site quality, Google's local results, and 6 live checks across ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI. The sites range from 55 to 86. The AI engines name only three of the 14, and all eleven studios in Encino, North Hollywood, Reseda, Sherman Oaks, Tarzana and Van Nuys were never named once. The field averages 59 (D) on AI readiness, 14 of 14 have no FAQ or Q&A structured data, and 9 of 14 have no llms.txt file. Whichever studio closes that gap first changes the answer for everyone searching this market.

Prepared by SiteTradeIn · Market snapshot generated 18 Oct 2026 · Independent audit — not commissioned by any studio in the field · See the ranked list

About this report

This is a market-wide snapshot, not an audit of a single business. We picked one competitive local market — dance and ballroom instruction in the Glendale, CA area — and ran the same measurement against every studio that competes for it: an automated site-quality grade across seven categories, where each studio shows up in Google's local results, and 6 live checks asking three AI engines who they'd recommend for two real buyer queries. Every studio named below is graded on identical criteria, on the same day, with no advance notice.

The point isn't to single any one studio out — it's to show what an AI-search-era competitive landscape actually looks like once you measure it instead of guessing at it. If your studio is one of the 14 below, this is where you stand today.

What the field shows

  • Arthur Murray Dance Studio Glendale (86) and Arthur Murray Dance Studio Sherman Oaks (83) lead on site quality, and the field runs down to 55. One score is shared.
  • No studio earns an A for AI readiness. The field averages 59 (D) on the category that decides whether an AI engine can read, trust and quote a site; the best score in the market is 85.
  • None of the 14 studios has FAQ or Q&A structured data, and 9 have no llms.txt file — the two cheapest AI-answer signals available. No studio in the market has both.
  • Two of the 14 are franchise locations (two Arthur Murray); the rest are independent studios.
  • The gap between #1 and #14 is 31 points on identical criteria. Nothing in the scorecard requires a rebuild or a rebrand to close it — just the work.

What separates the winners from the rest

  • Off-site proof, not just on-site polish. AI answers draw on what other sites say about a studio, not just on its own pages, so reviews, directory listings and a complete Google profile carry real weight.
  • Being unmistakably “in Glendale.” Every AI mention went to a studio inside the city. Studios that serve Glendale from nearby towns need pages, profiles and listings that say so in the words people search.
  • A complete, specific site. The strongest sites have no missing H1s or meta descriptions, alt text on their images, and schema that describes what the studio actually is.
  • Content matched to how people actually ask. The broad question and the ballroom question pull from different result sets — a studio needs to answer both.

Methodology & notes

Field (14 studios): dancearthurmurrayglendale.com, arthurmurraythebest.com, motionon2.com, swaywithmedance.com, danceattractions.com, weddingdancelessonla.com, vivreballroom.com, brooklyndancesportclubla.com, thetangoroom.com, jtdancestudio.com, premierdancex.com, crystalartsdance.com, dance4ustudio.com, sslatindancestudio.com. Chosen from live Google searches on 18 Oct 2026: every adult ballroom, Latin or partner-dance studio with a working website that appeared in Google's local results for Glendale dance searches. The Los Angeles area is split into six pages: Los Angeles (the city and the Westside), Glendale (with the San Fernando Valley), Pasadena (the San Gabriel Valley), Long Beach (with the South Bay), Anaheim (north Orange County) and Irvine (central and south Orange County). The Valley studios are in the city of Los Angeles but are ranked here, apart from the city page. Dance Attractions and The Tango Room share a building in Sherman Oaks and are rated separately. Left out: Armenian-dance and youth schools that lead the Glendale answers (Character Dance Studio, Anoush, Ara Dance, Armenian Dance Center, Adana, Exclusive Dance Studio), studios with no website of their own (Vivat and Dynamic Duo, both named in the ballroom answers, plus Sloan & Sloan, Dance With Ani and DB Dance), Accent Dance Studios (its site didn't load), private instructors (Emma Mesrobian, Elias Ladas), EA Dance (its website belongs to a studio in Columbus), youth and multi-genre studios (LA Star Dance, Exceleration, RYG, Luna Entertainment), rental and rehearsal spaces (The Aesthetic Studios, Evolution Studios), Salseros LA (online classes), and Dance Masters in Agoura Hills (outside this area).

Site audit: the same SiteTradeIn engine run for every studio on 18 Oct 2026, up to six pages per site, seven categories.

AI visibility: 6 live checks — ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI, each asked “What are the best dance studios in Glendale, CA?” and “What are the best ballroom dance studios in Glendale, CA?” with a request for a top-five numbered list. Rankings are taken from each engine's own list; presence was confirmed by reading the raw response text, and every franchise mention was matched to its location. Each question was asked in a fresh session of each engine's web app (ChatGPT and Gemini in temporary, unpersonalized chats, Google's AI Mode), not through a developer API.

Google: local (Places) and first-page organic results captured in a live browser session on 18 Oct 2026 for “ballroom dance lessons glendale ca”; “dance lessons glendale ca”; “salsa lessons glendale ca”; “wedding dance lessons glendale ca”; “ballroom dance lessons sherman oaks ca”, plus the organic searches “best dance studios in glendale ca” and “ballroom dance studio glendale”. Each query named the city; results vary by searcher location and over time.

Independence. This report is a market-wide measurement, not commissioned by or customized for any single studio named in it.

Limits. AI answers and search results vary between runs and over time; these are a point-in-time sample, not a fixed ranking.
